text:
zoe: FYI — friend stopping by tomorrow with a baby in a stroller and an oversized crate (art prop) around 10:15. Need advice for drop-off and a temp badge. Can the loading dock take it or should courier leave at front? cc @frontdesk :baby_bottle:
frontdesk: We can handle it. For crates >1.5m please use Loading Dock B (call ahead so security opens gate). If it's a single small crate we can accept at front desk. Temp badge will be ready if you RSVP guest name. Is stroller going to be folded or do you need an extra storage spot?
sam: If stroller is folded we can stash it in the quiet room coat rack. If not, we have a fold-out rack by conference C that will fit two strollers temporarily. Also: the crate will probably need a dolly — does courier have one?
zoe: Courier said they can bring a dolly. Crate dims ~120x60x40 cm, not fragile but awkward. I'll add a note on the tracking. Do I need to pre-register the courier plate for dock access?
frontdesk: Yes pre-register licence plate to avoid wait. Send plate to this channel or DM. We'll alert Security. For large drop-offs please include contact phone.
jamal: I can help grab the crate from dock if someone meets courier. I'm free 10:00-10:30. If you want I'll take it to the staging area and wheel it to Huddle B for setup.
mika: Heads-up — last week the visitor kiosk threw a 502 on check-in for two people. Front desk manual override worked but FYI for the team.
frontdesk: Thanks, Mika. If kiosk fails, use manual sign-in form: https://redwood.example/manual-visitor and we'll print a temporary badge. Also note mailroom lockers are nearly full; large packages sometimes get routed to Offsite Storage C. If you prefer front desk hold, tag package as "hold-for-zoe".
zoe: Sending courier details now: Plate ABC-912, contact 555-0199, ETA 10:05. Also adding "hold-for-zoe" to label.
people-ops-bot: Temp badge created for Zoe's guest: BADGE-877 (valid 04/02 08:00-18:00). Loading Dock pass requested for plate ABC-912.
sam: Quick logistics question  can we reserve the fold-out rack? Who books that?
frontdesk: We don't book it formally but we'll mark it reserved on the whiteboard and add a calendar "stroller rack (reserved)" for 10:00-11:30.
jamal: I'll meet at 10:00 at the dock. Reply with "meet" if you can help move it to Huddle B.
zoe: meet
mika: can't, in meeting, sorry
sam: meet
frontdesk: All set. We'll call when the courier arrives. Reminder: please label anything going to Offsite Storage C with your name + dept.
zoe: thanks everyone, much appreciated :pray:
